commands.assertions: Iframe bridge suite passed 90 tests across 7 files, including exact-parent and origin admission, native shell request rejection, and oversized control payload rejection without navigation.

assertions: Same-origin messages from a non-admitted window are ignored.
Unrecognized native shell requests produce no native operation or result.
Messages over 64 KiB are rejected before command handling and do not mutate history.
limitations: Stale surface session fencing, iframe crash recovery, and prompt-injection authority tests remain open at the Portal host/application boundary.
